title: The VAPT Lifecycle
tagline: Knowing how to hack is not enough. You need to know what to test, when to test it, and how to deliver findings that actually get fixed.
description: Walk through all five phases of a professional VAPT engagement — from the first client call to the final report. Learn what a scope document contains, what Rules of Engagement actually govern, why reporting is the deliverable that justifies the entire engagement, and what happens when organisations treat security testing as a compliance checkbox.
author: Cyber Learn Team
learningObjectives: Name and describe the five phases of a VAPT engagement in order, and explain the primary activity and output of each phase
Explain what a scope document contains and why its precision determines the safety and legality of the entire engagement
Describe what a Rules of Engagement document governs, including timing, permitted techniques, escalation protocols, and data handling
Explain why the report — not the exploitation — is the deliverable a client pays for, and what a professional pentest report must contain
Identify the seven phases of the Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES) and explain how they map to a real engagement
